en: A vintage, sepia-toned aerial view over a lakeside town. In the foreground there is a densely built settlement with low houses, narrow streets and scattered trees. Beyond the town lies a wide lake with a mountainous, barren shore on the opposite side. The overall style and tone suggest an early 20th‑century photographic postcard. A small printed number appears in the bottom left corner, and a web watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is superimposed across the lower right.
